method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 131496014 ('HERA Halle Nord', building=industrial), used verbatim. Its centroid sits 37.7 m from the HERA tunnel ring (geometry:hera-tunnel-ring) at the ring's north end -- consistent with a surface hall built over the underground North interaction point. DESY's brochure 'HERA - Pointing the way' independently confirms 'H1 in the North Hall and ZEUS in the South Hall.' This is the surface building; no source gives the underground H1 hall/cavern's own footprint, so this also stands in for detector:h1 and detector:alps-ii (both placed at this site).
name: HERA Hall North (H1)
notes: Linked to the HERA North Hall site rather than to one detector, because both the H1 detector and ALPS II are placed at that site.

summary.plain: The surface hall over the HERA ring's North interaction point, home to the H1 detector (1992-2007) and now the ALPS II axion experiment.
